recipes.name: Rice cooked in eggshells (Gyeran-kkeopjilbap: 계란껍질밥)
ingredients: ⅓ cup short grain rice, soaked in cold water at least 30 minutes, drained
3 eggshells (How to empty egg whites and yolks from the shells below)
instructions: Make a hole on the center of the pointed end of an egg by tapping it with a metal chopstick, then carefully breaking and removing the shell around the hole with your fingers. Keep removing the shell a little by little until the hole is about ½ inch wide.

Insert the chopstick and pour out the egg insides into a pan. I put the egg into my earthenware pot to make steamed eggs later. Repeat it with the other 2 eggs and empty all the insides. Put the shells into a small baking dish, the pointed end up.
Fill each egg with 2 tablespoons soaked rice and 2 tablespoons water. A small funnel and the chopstick are very useful for this.
Preheat the broiler in the oven for a couple of minutes. Add the eggshells and rice. Broil for 20 minutes.
